title: Construction of By-pass and Diversion Roads, Baliuag Diversion Road, Baliuag, Bulacan
description: NETWORK DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM - CONSTRUCTION OF BY-PASS AND DIVERSION ROADS - BALIUAG DIVERSION ROAD, BALIUAG, BULACAN
colour_meaning: Look first: an official warning record, or two signs of risk together.
contractor: Jagonbuild Construction Corp. (For. Jagon Builders (winning bidder)

reasons.title: A bidder is named in an official action
reasons.detail: SYMS CONSTRUCTION TRADING: named in an official action on 25CC0252, status "filed" (2025-09-11; as reported)
reasons.evidence: A referral, charge, audit finding or suspension compiled by the team from a public source; status as reported.
checks: Open the source and confirm it names this firm, with the status word used (referred, charged, filed).
Note the date; check for later developments (dismissal, conviction, lifting of a suspension).

reasons.title: A bidder has a reported link to an official or investigation
reasons.detail: SYMS CONSTRUCTION TRADING: documented link to Sally Santos (owner): Testified as owner of SYMS at the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee that she borrowed other contractors' licences on the instruction of a DPWH engineer; later described as a state witne [testified, 2025-09-08; as reported]
more: SYMS CONSTRUCTION TRADING: documented link to Brice Ericson Hernandez (former Assistant District Engineer, DPWH Bulacan 1st District): SYMS owner Sally Santos testified she delivered about PHP 245M in cash in boxes to Hernandez's DPWH office in one day; Hernandez admitted receiving a box of money from SYMS. [testified, 2025-09-08; as reported]
reasons.evidence: From the team's register of company–person links reported in the news or hearings. Reported, not proven.
checks: Read the source article; confirm the link is stated there, not inferred.
Look for an official document (SEC filing, COA report, Ombudsman complaint) that confirms it.

reasons.title: Very fast award after bid opening
reasons.detail: Award made 4 days after the bid deadline (past road contracts awarded this fast had about twice the odds of termination)
reasons.evidence: Awards within 8 days of bid opening had about 2.1 times the odds of termination.
checks: Compare the bid-opening date with the Notice of Award date.
Ask whether post-qualification (checking the winner's documents and capacity) could be done that fast.

claude_note:
**Claude check (advice only):** The ABC of about 67.8M and the winner match DPWH, but DPWH gives no length; the tender documents state a 1.548 km road, so cost per km can be checked by hand.
**Sources:** confirmed on DPWH API (ABC and winner match; no length listed; no OpenSanctions match for SYMS Construction Trading; PhilGEPS notice not attached) · **Suggested next step:** check the source by hand
docs_note:
**Documents (advice only):** Scope is stated in numbers (1.548 lane-km road, 774 l.m. drainage canal, 30 m right-of-way) and the P67.76M ABC matches the card, but no itemised Bill of Quantities or specifications could be read; 17 of 61 pages are unreadable scans.
**Unusual compared with the standard Philippine Bidding Documents:** none found (equipment list includes a 60-ton vibro hammer pile driver, which is specific but not clearly stricter than usual)
